visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A ginger-and-white Shiba Inu dog stands on the cushion of a grey reclining sofa. A ginger-and-white cat is curled up asleep on the same sofa, partially covered by a light green blanket. A person's legs in blue pants are visible at the bottom. The background is a brightly lit indoor living area with kitchen cabinets and household items. (2) The dog looks at the cat and then shifts its front paws, preparing to move. A person's hand reaches in from the right to pet the dog's orange fur. The dog moves closer to the person, eventually stepping over their legs and settling its head down on the person's lap. The cat remains undisturbed in its position. (3) The camera zooms in to a close-up of the cat's face. The cat has its eyes tightly shut, appearing extremely relaxed and peaceful while sleeping. A small variety-show style text overlay appears near the cat's head.
